about: The credit chips' sounds in Story mode (src/chips.rs), made from formants when the game starts: see src/formants and pistol_formants.json's `about` for what everything here means.

chip.about: A credit chip picked up: a soft, rounded two-note blip going up - 'bo-ip' - warm and in the middle of the range, nothing thin or high to grate however many are picked up.
